verdict.rationale: The evidence consistently describes Perplexity's Sonar/Agent API as itself being an MCP server (hosted at api.perplexity.ai/mcp) that other AI assistants can plug into to use Perplexity's search tools — the opposite of the story, which asks whether a user can plug external MCP servers into Perplexity's product so its own model can use their tools. No documentation shows Sonar API acting as an MCP client that connects to arbitrary third-party MCP servers and invokes their tools.
